notes.zh: 审阅说明：战略指挥中心每完成一个建造阶段，由 on_megastructure_built / on_megastructure_upgraded 在建造国触发对应事件（并非选项链接）；各阶段按建造顺序排列。9003 的正文按帝国伦理（如奴役）有所不同（megastructure_events_1.txt:3755-3790）。
notes.en: Review note: each build stage of the Strategic Coordination Center fires its own event for the builder from on_megastructure_built / on_megastructure_upgraded (not option links); stages are shown in construction order. The text of 9003 varies with ethics (e.g. slaver; megastructure_events_1.txt:3755-3790).

notes.zh: 审阅说明：废墟是地图上预置的，不属于任何建造阶段；首次进入该星系时由 on_entering_system_first_time 触发。
notes.en: Review note: the ruin is a pre-placed map object, not a build stage; on_entering_system_first_time fires this event the first time a ship enters the system.

scope.zh: 战略指挥中心各建造阶段事件、给其他帝国的通知、废墟与修复事件。
scope.en: Strategic Coordination Center: build-stage events, notices to other empires, the ruin and restoration events.
